privacy.erasure_warning:
⚠️ **This action cannot be undone.**

Your profile, warnings, voice room settings, inventory, vouchers and activity history will be deleted — on every server the bot serves, not only this one.

Your coin balance **is kept** under an anonymous record, so the server's total economy does not change unnoticed; that record can no longer be linked to you.

Your active premium roles and rented items will be withdrawn.
